fields.subject: CopyMapper
fields.condition: a Batch has an operation registered through a model-collection Add overload
fields.response: obtain the destination-table definition text, COPY command text, and per-property row-writer for TModel from a process-lifetime cache keyed by typeof(TModel), building and caching all three by reflecting over the model's mapping attributes and compiling an expression-tree delegate the first time that typeof(TModel) key is used, and reusing the cached writer and text without recompiling once that compile has completed
fields.postcondition: the execution reports a cache hit when the cached Lazy wrapper for that Type already had its value created at the moment it was checked, or a cache miss when it did not; because that check happens before the Lazy's value is forced, concurrent first-time callers for the same previously-uncached Type can each observe no value created and each report a miss, even though only the one caller that actually forces the value performs the reflection and expression-tree compile — the others block on the same Lazy and receive its compiled result without compiling it themselves
